about: Made-up settings for scripts/test-route-snapshot.js's import of server.js. The runner adds PATH, and DATABASE_PATH, TMPDIR and HOME inside a fresh scratch folder; nothing else from the parent environment reaches the import. Kept here, not in the runner, because several of these names are server.js declarations, and a runner whose text names one is picked by the pre-push hook only when that declaration changes (scripts/lib/test-selection.js).
